overextended_claim: 1850 megachurches means 1850 paying institutional DAF technology contracts
actual_public_evidence: Hartford estimate of Protestant megachurch congregations and attendance
alternative_or_hidden_assumption: Most churches may accept direct gifts and use no fund platform; procurement incidence unknown
current_justified_clarity_result: No credible software TAM from congregation count
falsification_or_decision_test: Representative institution procurement contracts and paid customer count

overextended_claim: NCF $468m grants to churches in 2025 means megachurch DAF grants total $468m
alternative_or_hidden_assumption: Churches include small congregations of many traditions and category may have non-megachurch recipients
current_justified_clarity_result: Only NCF reported church category, not megachurch sector amount
falsification_or_decision_test: Grant-recipient EIN and congregation segment mapping with consent

overextended_claim: DAF always produces extra tax benefit over direct cash gifts to church
actual_public_evidence: DAF donor deductibility exists for some donors
alternative_or_hidden_assumption: 2026 nonitemizer direct qualifying cash deduction excludes DAF; account fees and timing
current_justified_clarity_result: Direct gift is often better for routine nonitemizer donors; compare by taxpayer
falsification_or_decision_test: 2026 eligible tax reviewed direct vs DAF donor scenarios
report_guardrail: do not recommend DAF purely as cash payment channel

overextended_claim: Church absent IRS charity database or Form990 is not eligible to receive a charitable gift
actual_public_evidence: IRS allows church automatic exemption and Form990 exceptions
alternative_or_hidden_assumption: Church may qualify automatically without ever applying or filing Form990
current_justified_clarity_result: Need eligibility checks that handle documented church exceptions
falsification_or_decision_test: Legal church exception verification and sponsor acceptable grantee evidence

overextended_claim: No church Form990 proves misconduct or ineffective philanthropy
alternative_or_hidden_assumption: An organization may disclose audited statements voluntarily, separate affiliated foundations may file, church law differs
current_justified_clarity_result: Public transparency incomplete; do not infer misappropriation
falsification_or_decision_test: Request voluntary audited church fund and spend data plus service outcomes

overextended_claim: A church-branded donor fund means the church legally owns the money
actual_public_evidence: Some church foundation marketing uses charity advised and legacy terms
alternative_or_hidden_assumption: Independent DAF sponsor may own assets and donor/church merely advise; designated fund differs
current_justified_clarity_result: Map every entity's donor/sponsor/grantee rights separately
falsification_or_decision_test: Signed charitable sponsor account agreements and fund ledger
report_guardrail: legal owner cannot be inferred from branding

overextended_claim: A WaterStone Charity Advised Fund is legally the same as a donor advised fund
actual_public_evidence: Both products have charity/advised fund language
alternative_or_hidden_assumption: Organization adviser, legal donor privileges and sponsor rights differ; classify contract
current_justified_clarity_result: Product legal form unknown absent contract
falsification_or_decision_test: Actual church account terms, IRS definition and fund structure

overextended_claim: Faith sponsor values alignment always causes better outcomes
actual_public_evidence: NCF/Signatry/AMCF describe aligned values and donor networks
alternative_or_hidden_assumption: Trust/mission fit may improve satisfaction but restrict eligible causes, fees and investment returns
current_justified_clarity_result: Community alignment is a donor preference, not universal social ROI
falsification_or_decision_test: Matched donor preference, grant destination, impact and full fee outcomes

overextended_claim: Tax compliant DAF grant to any charity is automatically zakat compliant
alternative_or_hidden_assumption: Zakat charity eligibility, timing and investment treatment require independent qualified religious review
current_justified_clarity_result: Religious constraints need explicit configurable governance and reviewer
falsification_or_decision_test: Sponsor case study with qualified Islamic philanthropy reviewers

overextended_claim: AMCF current DAF annual administration fee is definitely .65%/$125 or .75%/$175
actual_public_evidence: Two sponsor public paths /dafs and /dafs-2 show different schedules
alternative_or_hidden_assumption: Versioned schedule/product changes, cache age and actual signed agreement unknown
current_justified_clarity_result: Current fee remains unresolved until dated signed fee sheet
falsification_or_decision_test: Direct written fee contract as of chosen date
report_guardrail: do not average the contradictory pages

overextended_claim: Catholic parish endowment = donor advised fund
actual_public_evidence: Diocesan foundations market both endowments and DAFs
alternative_or_hidden_assumption: Parish designated fund may pay a fixed beneficiary and donors have no advisory rights
falsification_or_decision_test: Collect sample contract and beneficiary restriction clause
report_guardrail: no denominators from conflated fund types

overextended_claim: JCF FY2026 $1.3b fundholder gifts prove $1.3b annual fees or all Jewish donations
alternative_or_hidden_assumption: Grant throughput not vendor revenue and JCF not all Jewish giving
falsification_or_decision_test: FY audited fee revenue vs fundholder grants and national comparison sources
report_guardrail: no provider ARR from grant amount

overextended_claim: DAFs can fund candidate/PAC election activity because sponsor aligns with a political cause
actual_public_evidence: 501c3 educational nonpartisan civic activity may be eligible
alternative_or_hidden_assumption: Candidate campaign activity prohibited by c3, c4/c6 different legal status and tax rules
current_justified_clarity_result: No candidate/PAC channel through c3 DAF; isolate educational charitable grants legally
falsification_or_decision_test: Named eligible public charity and project grant purpose legal review
report_guardrail: no partisan program financing through DAF

overextended_claim: DAF can pay church conference tickets, college tuition or trade association dues
actual_public_evidence: DAF may grant to qualified c3
alternative_or_hidden_assumption: More-than-incidental donor benefits prohibited, sponsor policies differ for pledge issues
current_justified_clarity_result: Reject grants purchasing individual benefits; allow pure charity review
falsification_or_decision_test: Adversarial donor benefit fixtures and sponsor authorization records

overextended_claim: Inferred religion of individual donors is a legitimate acquisition targeting variable
actual_public_evidence: Affinity sponsor has religious or community name
alternative_or_hidden_assumption: Individuals may have different beliefs, privacy expectations, and cross-network giving
current_justified_clarity_result: Use institution-level publicly offered partnerships or opt-in donor preferences only
falsification_or_decision_test: Consent and privacy audit, avoid third-party sensitive personal attribute enrichment

overextended_claim: A cause-aligned campaign automatically reaches target beneficiaries or creates additional giving
actual_public_evidence: Funds organized around a visible mission
alternative_or_hidden_assumption: Outcomes require actual nonprofit settlement, program delivery, baseline and substitutes
current_justified_clarity_result: Track beneficiary and causal outcome not slogan or theme
falsification_or_decision_test: Nonprofit activity and independent program impact with counterfactual

overextended_claim: IRS Schedule D and 990 can produce complete religious DAF sector estimate
alternative_or_hidden_assumption: Churches and integrated auxiliaries may be 990-exempt, unknown grant-receipt flows
current_justified_clarity_result: Estimate with sponsor grantee data plus voluntary audits and disclose missingness
falsification_or_decision_test: Sponsor grant recipient taxonomy and disclosure bias reconciliation
report_guardrail: missing church filings not zero dollar

overextended_claim: White-label church DAF will be a profitable channel due to large attendance
actual_public_evidence: Strong 2026 megachurch attendance and donor engagement
alternative_or_hidden_assumption: Staff/budget legal sponsor integration, gift mix, procurement, price elasticity and conversion unknown
current_justified_clarity_result: Viable business opportunity only a research hypothesis
falsification_or_decision_test: 10-15 institutional interviews with purchasing power and actual fee willingness, compare direct-gift integration
report_guardrail: do not invest before paid procurement
